probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
15 (Currently amended) A method for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, wherein the information is provided by a media request broker in response to a selection of a hyperlink by the client computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier, wherein the unique signature is distinct from and separate from any URL or resource locator identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, wherein the selection is performed by the media request broker based on media-specific request criteria.

16 (Currently amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature __distinct from the hyperlink address itself__, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request __and transmitted to the media request broker for server selection__.

17 (Original) 

18 (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information __received from the client computer and analyzed according to media delivery criteria__.

24 (Currently amended) A system for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a client computer; a first server computer; a second server computer; and a media request broker in communication with the client computer and the first server computer, wherein the media request broker adds information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, wherein the information is provided by the media request broker in response to a selection of a hyperlink by the client computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier, wherein the unique signature is distinct from and separate from any URL or resource locator identifier; and the media request broker selects the first server computer based on the information added to the locator and media-specific request criteria.

25 (Currently amended) The system of claim 24, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature __distinct from the hyperlink address itself__, the system further comprising circuitry for selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request __and transmitted to the media request broker for server selection__.

27 (Currently amended) A computer program product for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising: a computer-readable medium; and program code on the computer-readable medium for: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, wherein the information is provided by a media request broker in response to a selection of a hyperlink by the client computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier, wherein the unique signature is distinct from and separate from any URL or resource locator identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, wherein the selection is performed by the media request broker based on media-specific request criteria.

28 (Currently amended) The computer program product of claim 27, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature __distinct from the hyperlink address itself__, the computer program product further comprising the program step of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request __and transmitted to the media request broker for server selection__.
